title: Unwanted Masterwork Scalemail
summary: Medium Armour gives AC 16 plus full Dexterity and Fire resistance.

fields.Exotic Material: AC 16 plus full Dexterity modifier, with no +2 cap and no Stealth Disadvantage. Source reports Medium Armour Master or Magic Initiate: Cleric overrides the feature, reducing the maximum Dexterity bonus to +3.
fields.Resistance: Fire resistance. Requires Medium Armour proficiency.
fields.Acquisition: Dammon at the Forge of the Nine in Act Three.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and exact item and dependency citations.
